negative_findings.description: Searched in Hungarian for a standalone Hungarian bank-card / payments professional association ('Magyar Bankkártya Szakmai Szövetség', 'kártyaszövetség tagjai'). No such independent association surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card-industry coordination in Hungary appears to sit INSIDE the Magyar Bankszövetség as its 'Bankkártya munkacsoport' and the 'Pénzforgalmi (PAD) + SEPA munkacsoport', not in a separate legal association. Card-scheme presence (Mastercard, Visa) is instead visible via Hungarian Fintech Association and DKSZ membership.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a wasted recurring crawl target and redirects payments-specific association monitoring to the Bankszövetség working-group pages, which are the real locus.

negative_findings.description: Ecommerce Hungary (ecommerce.hu) and Digitális Kereskedelmi Szövetség (dksz.hu) homepages were fetched looking for a 'tagjaink'/'tagok' directory page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither exposes a structured member directory from the homepage. Ecommerce Hungary describes member CATEGORIES (banks, payment providers such as Barion and Cofidis, logistics, ERP/CRM/BI integrators) and gives a contact email instead; DKSZ shows only board portraits and named partners (Mastercard, Google, DHL Express, PwC, IVSZ, Growww Digital, Boxy, Oander).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Actor extraction for the merchant/e-commerce payments side must fall back to logo walls, event sponsor pages and press releases rather than a clean roster scrape — higher extraction cost and lower recall.

negative_findings.description: Inspected the IVSZ member directory (ivsz.hu/tagok) for fintech/banking-IT identification.
negative_findings.result_summary: The directory's filters are by company SIZE (Mikro/KKV/Nagyvállalati/Multi/Társult) and by broad tagozat (Informatikai, Digitális, Startup és Scale-up, Telekommunikációs) — there is no financial-services or fintech facet. The first pages show general enterprise IT firms (4D Soft, 4iG, Abesse, ARCANUM Development) with no vertical marker.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Full pagination plus per-company enrichment (website/TEÁOR/reference-customer check) is required to isolate banking-relevant suppliers; a filter-only harvest would return mostly noise.

negative_findings.description: Searched hu for the Magyar Fintech Szövetség (MAFISZ/HFA) member registry.
negative_findings.result_summary: Open-web search largely returns the 2020 founding-member set (Bankmonitor, Barion, BÁV Faktor, Blueopes, Flexibill, Péntech, Rocketsheperd, TechTeamer, Tőkeportál). The current, much larger roster (~50+, incl. Revolut, Mastercard, Visa, Dorsum, Finshape, BÉT) is only visible by fetching hunfintech.com/hu/tagok directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Search-engine-mediated collection would materially under-count and date-skew the fintech actor map; direct directory fetch must be the primary method for this association.

negative_findings.description: The MKIK national chamber registry KNYR (https://knyr.mkik.hu/Kamreg/Nyilvantarto/Kereses) and the inferred IPAR 4.0 member index (https://i40platform.hu/hu/szervezet/tagok/) were identified via search snippets and URL-pattern inference, not fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both URLs are recorded with confidence below that of directly fetched pages. KNYR is a query-form application, so a plain GET may not return content even when the service is healthy.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream liveness verification should not mark these dead on a single non-200/empty response; they need form-aware or browser-based checking.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a Hungarian-language umbrella term or association covering 'payment service providers' / acquirers as a membership body distinct from banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated 'pénzforgalmi szolgáltatók szövetsége' style body was found. PSPs appear scattered across the Fintech Association, Ecommerce Hungary and IVSZ. The only sector-wide enumeration of payment service providers appears to be regulator-side (MNB registers), which falls outside this association/chamber cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms there is no association-based shortcut to a complete PSP/acquirer list in Hungary; that enumeration must be sourced from the regulator cell instead, and this cell should not be asked to close that gap.

coverage_gaps.description: Savings-cooperative / integrated-cooperative and regional-bank representation bodies were not separately located in this pass; after the MBH consolidation it is unclear whether a distinct takarékszövetkezeti interest body still maintains a public member roster.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted hu queries on 'takarékszövetkezetek szövetsége', 'Országos Takarékszövetkezeti Szövetség OTSZ', 'szövetkezeti hitelintézetek integrációja' and check whether such rosters survive post-consolidation; if not, record as a structural negative finding.

coverage_gaps.description: Association CONFERENCE and EVENT sponsor/exhibitor lists were not systematically harvested. Bankszövetség, IVSZ, HFA (Budapest Fintech Week) and Ecommerce Hungary all run events whose sponsor tiers reveal which vendors are actively spending to reach Hungarian banks — often the fastest signal of a new market entrant.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add event/sponsor pages of each association in this cell as a dedicated recurring crawl set, keyed on 'szponzorok', 'kiállítók', 'partnereink', 'előadók'.

coverage_gaps.description: Case studies are the weakest topic in this cell. Association directories enumerate WHO exists but rarely document WHAT was implemented at which bank; only Bankszövetség publications and NJSZT/IVSZ conference material hint at implementation detail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat association sources as actor-map builders, and pair each identified vendor with a per-vendor reference/case-study crawl in the vendor-website cell rather than expecting case studies here.

coverage_gaps.description: Most rosters in this cell exist only in Hungarian; English versions (Bankszövetség /en/, HFA's English Fintech Report) are abridged and lag the Hungarian pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Configure the collector to prefer the hu URL as canonical for every association source and use the en variant only for narrative reports; do not deduplicate hu/en pages as equivalent.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-funded cluster/EDIH consortium rosters (e.g. DigitalTech EDIH, of which Blockchain Hungary is a consortium member) and the Blockchain Koalíció founder list were identified only indirectly and not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Follow the coalition/EDIH links from blockchainhungary.org and the eGov Hírlevél announcement to their consortium pages and extract full partner lists; EDIH consortia are publicly documented under EU transparency rules.

brief: Hungary's association layer gives an unusually clean, three-tier actor map: Magyar Bankszövetség enumerates the demand side (~60-70 credit institutions plus infrastructure bodies GIRO, KELER, BISZ), the Hungarian Fintech Association (hunfintech.com) is the densest single page of banking/payments vendors and challengers (Barion, Revolut, Mastercard, Visa, Dorsum, Finshape, Billingo, BÉT), and IVSZ's ~19-page tagok directory captures the long tail of Hungarian IT suppliers invisible to English search. Chambers (MKIK's KNYR registry, county chambers, BKIK's financial-services section) act as the near-census fallback for entity resolution, while niche bodies — Lízingszövetség with its supplier-revealing 'pártoló tagok' page, Faktoring Szövetség, Ecommerce Hungary, DKSZ, Blockchain Hungary's ecosystem map, the AI Coalition roster — fill in adjacent segments. The main structural weaknesses are that no independent Hungarian card/PSP association exists (that agenda sits inside Bankszövetség working groups and must otherwise be sourced from the regulator), that the e-commerce bodies publish no structured member directory, and that IVSZ offers no financial-services facet, so vendor isolation requires full pagination plus per-company enrichment.
